hot.rule: High-crash junction: 4 or more crashes since 2021 within 75 ft, or any fatal crash since 2015. Exposed: on the city's High-Injury Network, or no bike facility at 35 mph or more, or 3 or more crashes since 2021 per quarter mile (on a shorter edge, 3 or more on it).

sw.rule: Sidewalks from the city's inventory (existing, active) whose midpoint is within 40 ft of a street coded L, EL, UA or UF; joined to the streets at a junction within 20 m or mid-block

osm.rule: OpenStreetMap ways tagged path, footway, cycleway, pedestrian, track or bridleway (not sidewalks or crossings, not closed to bikes or private), kept only where they run farther than 60 ft from an edge the city's files hold, cut where they cross each other, joined to the network at their ends
